info.title: Get Request Cost API
info.description: Query status, usage, and actual cost by Request ID for synchronous API calls, primarily to text models

get.description:
Query the status, token usage, and actual charges of a request by Request ID. This endpoint is for **synchronous API calls**, primarily to **text models** through Chat Completions, Messages, or Responses. For asynchronous tasks (image, video, or audio generation), use `GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}` instead.

- Usage becomes available shortly after the request completes. Requests still in progress return 404.
- You can only query requests belonging to your account. Any API Key under the same account can be used.
- Requests from the last 90 days can be queried.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Request ID from the `X-Request-Id` header of the original response. Omit the braces (`{}`) and append the ID directly to the path.

model.description: The model used for the request

status.description:
Request status:

- `completed`: The request completed successfully.
- `failed`: The request failed. If usage occurred before the failure (for example, a streaming response was interrupted), `usage` reports the charges actually deducted.
- `blocked`: The request was rejected before processing, for example because of insufficient account balance, an exhausted API Key quota, a disabled or expired API Key, or a model that is not allowed. No charges are incurred.

finished_at.description: Time the request ended (Unix timestamp in seconds)

usage.description: Usage and cost. Always returned; all values are 0 if no charges were incurred.

cached_tokens.description: Number of input tokens served from the cache

credits_used.description: Credits actually deducted for this request

cost.description: The request cost expressed in three currencies, converted from `credits_used` and rounded up. The USD amount uses the exchange rate at the time of the charge.

error.description: The failure reason, returned only when `status` is `failed` or `blocked`. Contains a message only, without an error code. To handle errors by code, use the error returned by the original request.

bearerAuth.description:
All endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

**Get an API Key:**

Visit the [API Key management page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to obtain your API Key.

**Include the following request header:**
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```
